stage_inventory.official: MneRaw reads the MNE raw event, with allow_maxshield=True in v1 config.
MegExtractor picks ('meg',), drops no bad channels by default, and uses channel_order='unique'.
stage_inventory.neuroselect: raw.pick('meg'); no bad-channel dropping or channel reordering is applied.

stage_inventory.official: apply_proj=False; no MNE projectors are applied.
Fit RobustScaler per continuous MNE recording after resampling.
stage_inventory.neuroselect: Fit RobustScaler per continuous recording after resampling.

stage_inventory.official: Study event extraction plus SpanishBCBLPreprocessing creates Keystroke and Sentence events.
stage_inventory.neuroselect: Reuses Study and SpanishBCBLPreprocessing._run, then saves events_clean.pkl.

stage_inventory.official: Segments begin at Keystroke.start plus start=-0.2 seconds.
stage_inventory.neuroselect: Event center is rounded to a 50 Hz sample relative to sentence signal_start.

stage_inventory.official: 0.5 second window beginning 0.2 seconds before the keypress.
stage_inventory.neuroselect: 25 samples from -0.2 to +0.3 seconds after sample rounding.

stage_inventory.official: Per event window baseline: subtract mean over relative [0.0, 0.2] seconds, then crop to analysis window.
stage_inventory.neuroselect: Subtract mean over first 0.2 seconds of the sentence crop before event windows are extracted.

stage_inventory.official: Clamp each extracted event tensor to +/-5.
stage_inventory.neuroselect: Clamp each sentence signal to +/-5 before event windows are extracted.

stage_inventory.official: Neural extractor returns C,T; SegmentDataset adds batch dimension, so model input is N,C,T.
stage_inventory.neuroselect: Manifest loader returns T,C and ConvCTC consumes N,T,C.

stage_inventory.official: Keystroke LabelEncoder uses predefined BUTTON_MAPPING, 29 classes, no one-hot.
stage_inventory.neuroselect: SpanishBCBL vocabulary uses the same character order with a CTC blank prepended.

stage_inventory.official: Sentence events are rebuilt over observed keystrokes; sentence_typed is concatenated actual button sequence.
TF-IDF paraphrase-similarity clusters are greedily assigned to train/val/test at 0.8/0.1/0.1, seed 1.
stage_inventory.neuroselect: Subset manifest preserves the official split labels for selected trials.

stage_inventory.official: Drops controls/excluded subjects, merges duplicate subject IDs, factorizes subject IDs; subject ID and channel positions are extractor inputs.
stage_inventory.neuroselect: Uses one S22 session/block and stores subject/session metadata, but does not feed subject IDs or channel positions to ConvCTC.
